'''2010 Dagobah Regionals Andrew Morris DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Andrew Morris]] at [[2010 Dagobah Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
